, isn’t the only foreign leader to have inspired a particular reaction from the Israeli prime minister.
In late 2015, after Trump had withdrawn his interest in running for president, he denounced what he termed a "dangerous" nuclear deal between Iran and six world powers.
Starting from November, Netanyahu has conducted "Trump Weekly" on Facebook and YouTube, a weekly discussion with Likud politicians, media personalities, and experts who provide what he calls a blueprint for America. His assaults have been rapid and unforgiving, much like US prosecutors accusing Netanyahu of tax evasion and bribery.
He also mocked the "elite" media during US President Donald Trump's visit to India.
